reviewers.summary: The study is an ungoverned, exploratory evaluation of a single risk score without any internal validation, calibration assessment, or essential descriptive statistics. The manuscript contains contradictory claims about available estimates and lacks documentation of the outcome, the risk score's origin, and event rates. The analysis is not bound to a pre-specified protocol and cannot support any clinical or public-health inference.

findings.title: Unclear origin and development of the risk score
evidenceRefs: paper.md: mentions only 'risk_score' variable, no derivation details
stats-run/stats-run.json: variables list includes 'risk_score' but no provenance
findings.whyItMatters: Without knowing whether the risk score was derived from the same dataset, it is impossible to assess overfitting and external validity. A prediction model study must describe all predictors and their sources.
findings.actionableFix: Document how the risk score was computed, including any derivation from the same data, the formula or algorithm, and whether model development was part of this analysis or prior work.

findings.title: Absence of internal validation
evidenceRefs: paper.md: no mention of cross-validation, bootstrap, or split-sample
stats-run/stats-run.json: only apparent performance metrics (AUROC, Brier) on full sample
findings.whyItMatters: Apparent performance overestimates generalizability, especially with a small sample. Internal validation is mandatory for any prediction model to quantify optimism.
findings.actionableFix: Perform internal validation (e.g., bootstrap, k-fold cross-validation) and report optimism-corrected AUC and Brier score with confidence intervals.

findings.title: Missing event rate and confidence intervals
evidenceRefs: paper.md: no outcome event count, no CIs
stats-run/stats-run.json: provides AUROC=0.718, Brier=0.213, but no CI
findings.whyItMatters: AUROC interpretation depends on event prevalence; CIs are needed to assess precision. Absence prevents meaningful interpretation and comparison.
findings.actionableFix: Report the number (and proportion) of events in the outcome, and provide 95% bootstrap or DeLong confidence intervals for AUROC.

findings.title: Calibration not assessed
evidenceRefs: paper.md: only Brier score mentioned, no calibration plot
stats-run/stats-run.json: no calibration slope or intercept, no calibration plot
findings.whyItMatters: Brier score alone does not differentiate between miscalibration and discrimination. Calibration is essential for clinical usefulness; poorly calibrated predictions can mislead risk stratification.
findings.actionableFix: Generate a calibration plot (observed vs. predicted probabilities), report calibration-in-the-large and calibration slope, and if appropriate, perform decision-curve analysis.

findings.title: Contradictory limitation statement about missing estimates
evidenceRefs: paper.md: Limitations section claims 'No estimate-like records were available...'
stats-run/stats-run.json: contains estimates array with AUROC and Brier score
findings.whyItMatters: This discrepancy suggests the manuscript was not updated after the analysis run, undermining its credibility and indicating automation or templating errors.
findings.actionableFix: Remove or correct the false limitation; integrate the actual estimate records into the results section and discuss them appropriately.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check presence of 'estimates' key in stats-run.json

findings.title: Analysis unbound to pre-specified protocol (exploratory posture)
evidenceRefs: stats-run/stats-qa.json: warnings about binding and result posture
findings.whyItMatters: The analysis is not governed by a pre-registered AnalysisSpec or method-selection evidence. Any inference is purely exploratory and cannot support confirmatory claims.
findings.actionableFix: Create an AnalysisSpec and method-selection record that pre-specify the modeling approach, validation strategy, and reporting; rerun under that binding before promoting results.

findings.title: Insufficient descriptive statistics for outcome and predictor
evidenceRefs: stats-run/stats-run.json: only N=360, no event count, no risk score summary
findings.whyItMatters: Without descriptive statistics, reviewers cannot assess data quality, potential outliers, class imbalance, or data leakage that could invalidate the analysis.
findings.actionableFix: Provide summary statistics (mean, SD, range) for risk_score, and frequency/counts for outcome_bin, along with any missingness patterns prior to complete-case exclusion.

findings.title: ROC curve figure may be poorly formatted
findings.whyItMatters: A very low nonBlankRatio suggests the figure is mostly white space, potentially making it difficult to interpret at a glance and indicating a layout issue.
findings.actionableFix: Adjust the figure dimensions, aspect ratio, or plot margins to improve the data-ink ratio. Consider combining with calibration plot in a multi-panel figure.

missingEvidence: Risk score source and derivation details
Confidence intervals for AUROC and Brier score

reviewers.summary: The manuscript is a placeholder with critical omissions: no predictive metrics reported, exploratory unbound analysis, potential figure defect, and insufficient model evaluation. Blocked for thorough revision.

findings.title: Stats run is unbound and exploratory, not prespecified
findings.whyItMatters: Without binding to a pre-registered method-selection or analysis spec, the analysis is post-hoc and cannot support confirmatory claims. Risk of p-hacking and overoptimistic performance metrics is high.
findings.actionableFix: Clearly label as exploratory, downgrade conclusions, or obtain a prespecified analysis plan and re-run.

findings.title: Paper fails to report the primary predictive metrics (AUROC, Brier score)
findings.whyItMatters: The paper's Results section only states sample size, omitting the actual outcome of the analysis (AUROC 0.718, Brier 0.213). This makes the paper unreviewable and useless for interpretation.
findings.actionableFix: Add a table with AUROC, Brier score, and their 95% confidence intervals.
findings.deterministicVerification: Compare reported numbers to stats-run.json estimates.

findings.title: No confidence intervals for predictive metrics
findings.whyItMatters: AUROC and Brier score are point estimates; without CIs, the uncertainty is unquantified, making it impossible to assess the precision of the discrimination and calibration estimates.
findings.actionableFix: Report 95% CIs (e.g., DeLong for AUROC, bootstrap for Brier) or provide in stats-run output.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check if CI computation method is documented and results plausible.

findings.title: ROC curve figure has extremely low non-blank ratio (0.024), likely empty or misrendered
findings.whyItMatters: A non-blank ratio of 2.4% suggests the plot area is mostly white; the ROC curve may not be visible, undermining the figure's utility.
findings.actionableFix: Regenerate the figure, ensure proper axis ranges and data plotting, verify visually.
findings.deterministicVerification: Examine roc-curve.png file and compare with data dimensions.

findings.title: Limited calibration evaluation: only Brier score, no calibration plot or slope/intercept
findings.whyItMatters: Brier score is a combined measure; calibration intercept and slope, calibration plot, and decision curve analysis are standard for risk model evaluation. Without them, calibration quality cannot be fully judged.
findings.actionableFix: Include calibration plot, expected/observed table, and ideally calibration slope and intercept in the analysis.

findings.title: Risk score variable source and computation not described
findings.whyItMatters: The evaluation is contingent on the risk score; without describing how it was derived (model, coefficients, predictors), the analysis is irreproducible and opaque.
findings.actionableFix: Document the risk score derivation, including the underlying model, predictors, and validation steps before evaluating performance.

findings.title: Paper contains stale template statements that contradict available evidence
findings.whyItMatters: The paper claims 'No reader-facing paper/manuscript artifact was found' and 'No estimate-like records were available', suggesting it was not updated after stats run. This undermines the credibility of the manuscript as a final product.
findings.actionableFix: Remove or update generic meta-commentary to reflect actual artifacts.

findings.title: No baseline characteristics, outcome prevalence, or risk score distribution reported
findings.whyItMatters: To interpret predictive performance, one needs to know outcome prevalence and the spread of the risk score. Without these, the clinical context is missing.
findings.actionableFix: Provide a Table 1 with cohort demographics, outcome frequency, and summary statistics of risk score.

missingEvidence: Pre-specified analysis plan or method-selection artifact
Confidence intervals for AUROC and Brier score
Derivation details for the risk score
Table of baseline characteristics and outcome prevalence
Reproducible analysis code or pipeline specification

reviewPanel.nextAction: Adjudicate findings and route accepted repairs back into the pipeline.
